_comment: MARKETING template. May only be sent to a contact returned by the
marketable_contacts view — i.e. one holding a live direct_marketing consent event.
Character budget: body text below is 937 characters as written, against Meta's
1,024 limit. The sender identity and opt-out address are HARDCODED, not variables —
POPIA s69(4) requires both in every direct marketing communication, and a variable
can be passed empty. Only the first name is parameterised.
Before submitting, replace [REGISTERED ENTITY NAME] and [STREET ADDRESS]. Those two
substitutions change the length; re-measure if the entity name is long.

components.text:
Hi {{1}}, is your home going on auction?

We DO NOT buy houses. This is not an offer to purchase.

*Consumer Credit Law* is a consumer credit consultancy. We work for homeowners, never for the bank.

Under Rule 46A a court must consider alternatives before a primary residence is sold in execution.

*Our fee is upfront and set by property value. Total, or over two months:*
- Under R500,000 = R18,000 (R9,000 x 2)
- R500,000-R800,000 = R24,000 (R12,000 x 2)
- R800,000-R1.2m = R34,000 (R17,000 x 2)
- R1.2m-R1.5m = R36,000 (R18,000 x 2)
- Above R1.5m = R44,000 (R22,000 x 2)

Court work is done by independent affiliate attorneys. We are not a law firm. No outcome is guaranteed.

Free guides on section 129 letters, summonses and sale in execution: creditlaws.co.za

Send us your court papers. The earlier we start, the more options are open.

[REGISTERED ENTITY NAME] t/a Consumer Credit Law, [STREET ADDRESS], Fourways, Johannesburg.
Reply STOP and we will not message you again.
